trends.name: Iran Conflict Escalates Oil/Inflation Crisis
trends.summary: Iran-US tensions are driving oil prices higher with direct economic spillover effects. USPS announcing first-ever 8% fuel surcharge on packages, while Wall Street increases recession warnings due to geopolitical risk and inflation concerns. Western intelligence reports suggest Iran leadership has lowered threshold for military action, raising stakes.

trends.name: Meta Liable for Youth Addiction — Regulatory Risk
trends.summary: LA jury found Meta and YouTube negligent in social media addiction lawsuit; New Mexico AG calls it 'landmark decision' signaling industry-wide expectations for child safety. This opens Meta to significant regulatory and legal exposure with implications for entire tech sector's content moderation practices and liability frameworks.

trends.name: AI Chip Dominance — Amazon vs. Competition
trends.summary: Amazon positioned on right side of AI chip split as Super Micro, Dell, and HPE stocks rallied. Conversely, Micron stock dropping with Google potentially blamed for shifting chip strategy. Winners and losers in AI infrastructure race becoming clear with major implications for data center and semiconductor valuations.

trends.name: Trump Impeachment Odds Spike to 73%
trends.summary: Kalshi prediction markets show Trump impeachment probability surged to 73%, trending steadily higher in recent months. This creates significant political uncertainty affecting markets, policy continuity, and investor risk appetite amid ongoing Middle East tensions and economic concerns.

trends.name: Hormuz Strait Disruption — Supply Chain/Logistics
trends.summary: Maritime traffic disruption in Hormuz Strait driving transit fee increases; France mobilizing military coalition to restore navigation. Logistics costs potentially doubled for some routes, threatening global supply chains and creating cost inflation across shipping and trade-dependent sectors.

trends.name: Housing Market Stress from War/Mortgage Rates
trends.summary: Iran war threatening US housing recovery not just through mortgage rate increases but broader economic uncertainty. Rising oil/inflation pressures mortgage rates while geopolitical risk dampens homebuyer sentiment. Single women and first-time buyers particularly challenged as wealth-building strategy via homeownership becomes harder to execute.

trends.name: Private Credit Market Trapped in Hotel California
trends.summary: Private credit market reaching inflection point where investors face 'easy entry, hard exit' dynamics. Rising rates and economic uncertainty creating redemption pressure while illiquid positions trap capital, creating systemic risk for credit-dependent corporates and portfolio managers.

trends.name: SpaceX IPO Filing Expected Imminent
trends.summary: Space stocks rallying on reports of SpaceX's imminent IPO filing, signaling major capital market event. Massive implications for space/defense/satellite sector valuations and investor appetite for high-growth, cash-burning tech ventures in uncertain macro environment.

trends.name: Stock Market Predictor Flashing Bearish Signal
trends.summary: A 'single greatest' market-timing indicator has never been more bearish, signaling elevated downside risk. This contrarian signal—combined with recession warnings and geopolitical tension—suggests profit-taking and increased equity volatility ahead, pressuring risk-on positioning.

trends.name: JetBlue Merger Talks Lift Airline Valuation
trends.summary: JetBlue stock turns positive for year on merger speculation, providing bright spot in airline sector faced with fuel surcharges and TSA/operational headwinds. M&A activity potentially reshaping US carrier consolidation amid cost pressures.

trends.name: US-China Diplomacy Reset — Xi-Trump May Meeting
trends.summary: White House confirms Trump will meet Xi in China in May, signaling potential reset in US-China relations. Could impact tariffs, tech competition, and trade normalization amid broader geopolitical uncertainty; critical for semiconductor and manufacturing sectors.

trends.name: Reverse Mortgage Liability — Senior Borrower Risk
trends.summary: Reverse mortgage products creating unexpected liability exposure for borrowers who run out of funds; lenders clarifying enforcement mechanisms. Growing concern about senior financial security and product transparency in aging population segment with major implications for wealth inequality.
